## HandlerInboundMessage type

Provides exact typing for the AgentMessage in the message context in the `handle` function of a handler. It takes all possible types from `supportedMessageTypes`

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
export declare type HandlerInboundMessage<H extends Handler> = InboundMessageContext<InstanceType<H['supportedMessages'][number]>>;
```
<b>References:</b> [Handler](./core.handler.md)<!-- -->, [InboundMessageContext](./core.inboundmessagecontext.md)

## Example


```ts
class MyHandler implements Handler {
 public async handle(messageContext: HandlerInboundMessage<BasicMessageHandler>) {
   // method implementation
 }
```
